attestations.text: LIU Hsi-hai 劉喜海 (T. 燕庭), d. 1853, official and scholar, was a native of Chu-ch'êng, Shantung. He was a great-grandson of the Grand Secretary, Liu T'ung-hsün [q. v.], and the son of Liu Huan-chih (see under Liu T'ung-hsün).
